decision: Use normal pinned frozen pnpm installations with private module metadata and copy imports; share only the official package store
why: Frequent parallel work must preserve primary and peer installations; shared node_modules links cannot qualify
evidence: #1368 criteria1-3,7; owner frequent-parallel requirement; manual private install logs1366/1367/1368
result: Implement a rerunnable public CLI; no dependencies or provisioning changes

decision: Acquire an atomic target-specific lock before creation, with unique owner records; never recursively remove lock state or infer abandonment from age
why: Simultaneous creators and stale-recovery races must not replace live ownership; a dead parent may leave installer descendants
evidence: #1368 criteria4-6; dangerous ordering owner death while installer lives
result: Prove owned process-group exit on POSIX; ambiguous launch state and unprovable Windows descendant state fail closed; graceful interruption and normal retry remain supported

decision: Hash actual dependency/configuration/runtime inputs and installation metadata before reuse and before publishing ready; changed or unknown inputs need explicit refresh
why: An unchanged source commit does not establish dependency equivalence; preparation can race input edits
result: Persist technical hashes/stages only; suppress arbitrary installer output; no global dependency-check bypass

decision: Atomically record idle, launching or running plus the owned child process-group identity in the unique owner file; clear running only after observed descendant exit
why: SIGKILL leaves a real pnpm child alive; dead parent PID alone allowed overlapping installation in the public failing regression
result: Use existing POSIX group controller; unprovable launch gaps/Windows orphan state remain locked rather than guessing

decision: Run the built-in-only public CLI tests on a native Windows CI job and require it through quality; route doctor pnpm probes through the existing argv-safe Bash launcher using its public runner seam
why: Frequent parallel preparation must have honest platform evidence; Windows cannot execute a cmd shim directly with shell:false
evidence: #1368 criteria6-7; existing doctor adapter runner contract
result: No new installer or dependency; POSIX graceful cancellation and Windows conservative abrupt-interruption behavior remain distinct
